Jordan (Sales): Quick heads-up 1: prospect is an EU bank. Legal just flagged two hard requirements: (1) no cross-border at-rest for customer data (EU-only), (2) subprocessor evidence + CAIQ snippets for controls mapping. They want a one-pager + subproc CSV by EOD Fri. Can we deliver? @Priya @Omar

Priya (Solutions): Clarify: is this for a Hosted trial or Dedicated POC? Hosted by default will have control plane in us-east-1 but we can enable EU-only routing for customer data if they enable the routing flag. Dedicated is cleaner for EU-only at-rest.

Jordan (Sales): They asked for Hosted POC but said they'd consider Dedicated if hosted can't meet "data at rest never leaves EU".

Omar (Security): Short answer: hosted default persists in us-east-1, so fails strict EU-only at-rest. However we can offer two mitigations: (A) EU-only routing with storage in eu-west-1 + EU KMS CMKs (limited GA/on request), or (B) Dedicated in EU with customer tenant pinned to eu-west-1. I can draft a CAIQ snippet showing how our controls map to their questions. Need to know which subprocessors are required for hosted EU routing.

Lena (Eng): For hosted EU routing we can restrict compute + storage to eu-west-1. Subprocessors involved: AWS (eu-west-1 services), Datadog (EU tenant if requested), Sentry (can be disabled), Cloudflare (global edge, only headers forwarded), Segment (opt-in). Also note: backups currently replicate to eu-west-1 only if EU-routing enabled; no cross-region replica will be created.

Priya (Solutions): I'll produce the CSV mapping. Columns: subprocess_name, region, service_purpose, data_types_touched, retention_policy, legal_docs_link, contact_owner. Ill mark optional subprocessors. Will include KMS ARN placeholders like "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:xxxx:alias/redwood-eu" unless customer BYOK.

Jordan (Sales): The buyer asked specifically for pseudonymization proof. How do we describe that?

Omar (Security): We pseudonymize user identifiers by HMAC-SHA256 with a per-tenant salt stored in KMS-wrapped secret. For the POC we can show a small code snippet and a redacted log sample. PII in logs is redacted by default; application traces can be disabled. Will add note about deterministic vs non-deterministic hashing and re-identification controls.

Lena (Eng): Pasting quick ascii boundary sketch for the deliverable:

```
Client (EU) -> Edge (Cloudflare) -> Load balancer (eu-west-1) -> Redwood API (eu-west-1)
  -> Inference runtime (GPU cluster, eu-west-1)
  -> KV cache (redis, eu-west-1)
  -> Persistent storage (S3, eu-west-1) [encrypted with KMS eu-west-1]
Observability: Datadog EU tenant (eu-west-1) or disabled
Backups: S3 snapshots (eu-west-1) TTL=90d (configurable)
```

Priya (Solutions): ETA: Ill deliver draft CSV + short PDF summary by EOD today. Omar, can you provide CAIQ snippets + evidence links (DPA, SOC2) by tomorrow morning?

Omar (Security): Yes. Ill include references to our DPA, SCCs, and a SOC2 cover page. Also include a clear callout where Hosted requires explicit EU-routing opt-in and that the default hosted offering is US.

Jordan (Sales): Great. Ill tell legal were on it. If they insist on absolute EU-only at-rest, we should also give cost delta for Dedicated EU capacity. Sam from finance will need the usage profile.

infra-bot: Uploaded: https://artifacts.example.com/1754326789/eu-poc-diagram-v1.pdf

Priya (Solutions): Uploaded draft CSV: https://redwood.example.com/shared/eu-bank-subproc-matrix-1754326789.csv -- includes optional toggles and BYOK note. Please review and flag any missing subprocessors.

Jordan (Sales): Thanks team. If legal comes back with additional control queries Ill post them here. :raised_hands:
